confirm.run_sql: Execute this SQL file against the database? This cannot be undone.

hints.json_path: Path to the JSON file to convert, relative to the project root (e.g. data/recipes.json)
hints.slug: Optional lowercase slug for the generated SQL filename. Defaults to the table name.
hints.slug_safe_table: Lowercase letters and numbers only (used for the SQL filename slug)

ui.broken_views_hint: These views reference tables that no longer exist and were skipped during introspection. Recreate the missing tables (e.g. via Run SQL file), then reload.
ui.busy: Processing — the page will refresh when complete.
ui.compliance_hint: Introspects the live DB and reports columns that do not match the canonical domain types. Read-only.
ui.database_description: Run SQL files, seed data from JSON and check domain compliance.
ui.data_to_sql_hint: Upload JSON, XLS, or XLSX data and generate paired MySQL and SQLite SQL files.
ui.json_upload_hint: Select a file to inspect its contents before choosing what to import.
ui.sheet_selection_hint: Select one or more sheets and review the suggested table names.
ui.sql_files_hint: Choose a SQL file to run against the current database.
